workspace.unreachable: The local server is not reachable. Start it with docker compose up -d app; the list comes back by itself.
workspace.failed: The server could not load the CVs; see docker compose logs app. Trying again every few seconds.
workspace.empty: No CVs yet. Ask Claude to create one, add an example with docker compose exec dev pnpm seed, or bring CVs from an earlier version with docker compose exec dev pnpm import:files.

connectClaude.title: Connect Claude
connectClaude.intro: Markup Résumé gives Claude tools to list, read and write your CVs. The app serves them itself while it is running.

code.title: Claude Code
code.text: Open this project folder in Claude Code. It finds the Markup Résumé server in .mcp.json and asks once to enable it. Run /mcp to check that it is connected.

desktop.title: Claude Desktop
desktop.text: Not available in this local setup yet: Claude Desktop connects only to servers with a public HTTPS address. It arrives with the hosted version.
